title: Matrices column counts Active matrices where the tier has its own rules
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, Active (it prices a new category made for this test).
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, Inactive (no category).
  • Note how many matrices the Matrices tab lists as Active (for example 5).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Check matrix A.
  4. Click Set Rule in the bulk bar after picking % Off with the value 10.
  5. Click Set Rule in the dialog.
  6. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  7. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  8. Check matrix B.
  9. Click Set Rule in the bulk bar after picking % Off with the value 10.
  10. Click Set Rule in the dialog.
  11. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A's Matrices column reads 0/5 (0 own rules of 5 Active matrices = 0/5).

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The bulk bar shows the count 1.

Step 4:

  • The Set Rule question opens.

Step 5:

  • Matrix A's row reads 10% off.

Step 6:

  • Tier A's Matrices column reads 1/5 (1 of 5).

Step 7:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 8:

  • The bulk bar shows the count 1.

Step 9:

  • The Set Rule question opens.

Step 10:

  • Matrix B's row reads 10% off.

Step 11:

  • Tier A's Matrices column still reads 1/5: the Inactive matrix B adds nothing.
  • Default's Matrices column reads All.
